summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K reporting the private exchange of shares of Series Q Perpetual Preferred Stock for common stock (31,958 and 32,710 shares in two separate agreements with Streeterville Capital). No third-party acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, or special situation is present. The exchanges were conducted under Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act and are routine capital-structure adjustments. The filing also notes the reconvened 2026 Annual Meeting with a supplemental proxy statement. This is a routine current report regarding a material definitive agreement for equity exchanges and a meeting update, not a special-situation event.
